name: Camping Inntal
beschreibung: Camping Inntal in Wiesing is designed as a campsite focusing on pitches for motorhomes and caravans. It is located on the Inntalautobahn near the Wiesing exit and is therefore suitable for travelers passing through as well as a base for excursions. The site offers hard-surfaced pitches with electricity and fresh water connections as well as a disposal station. A reception and a simple sanitary building are available. The surrounding area allows short drives to Achensee or the surrounding mountain regions.
